title: MedTVL: Harnessing Vision and Language for Medical Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.28605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal learning for medical time series (MedTS) classification highlight the benefits of integrating complementary modalities for clinical decision. However, existing methods typically focus on bi-modal interactions (e.g., time series and text), leaving the tri-modal synergy between time series, vision, and language largely unexplored. Inspired by diagnostic practice synergizing numerical assessment, visual inspection and clinical context, we introduce MedTVL, a text-guided dual-pathway architecture tailored for MedTS classification. Specifically, it synergizes a convolution-based temporal pathway for fine-grained temporal dynamics from raw numerical sequences and a transformer-based visual pathway for holistic morphological structures from time-series-derived images. translated_title: MedTVL：利用视觉与语言进行医学时间序列分类
translated_abstract: 医学时间序列（MedTS）分类多模态学习的最新进展凸显了整合互补模态对临床决策的益处。然而，现有方法通常聚焦于双模态交互（例如时间序列与文本），时间序列、视觉与语言之间的三模态协同在很大程度上仍未被探索。受诊断实践中数值评估、视觉检查与临床背景相协同的启发，我们提出了MedTVL，一种专为医学时间序列分类设计的文本引导双通路架构。具体而言，它协同了基于卷积的时间通路（从原始数值序列中提取细粒度时间动态）和基于Transformer的视觉通路（从时间序列生成的图像中提取整体形态特征）。这种跨模态与架构异质性的结合提供了全面的诊断视角。为进一步解决潜在的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MedTVL，一种文本引导的双通路架构，通过协同卷积时间通路与Transformer视觉通路，首次实现时间序列、视觉与语言三模态融合，用于医学时间序列分类。
en_tdlr: MedTVL, a text-guided dual-pathway architecture that synergizes a convolution-based temporal pathway and a transformer-based visual pathway, pioneering the tri-modal integration of time series, vision, and language for medical time series classification.
